title: Member discount
goal:
Before: returns price * qty minus 10% from 10 items, and another 5% for members (member == 1); each discount is taken from the unit price and rounded down (price 40, qty 2, member → 76; price 40, qty 3, member → 114).
Change: the member discount now applies only when the order total price * qty is at least 100 (price 40, qty 2, member → 80); nothing else changes.
Constraints: do not change either of the two if statements.

keep.desc: constraint 1: the first if is unchanged: if (qty >= 10) { pct = pct + 10; }
constraint 1: the second if is unchanged: if (member == 1 && total >= 100) { pct = pct + 5; }
